intro: Lesson 42. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: إِلَّا حَمِيمًۭا وَغَسَّاقًۭا (٢٥) جَزَآءًۭ وِفَاقًا (٢٦) إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًۭا (٢٧) وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًۭا (٢٨) وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًۭا (٢٩) فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا (٣٠) إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا (٣١) حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًۭا (٣٢)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
But all things We have enumerated in writing.
"So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -

questions.q: Chunk and link An-Naba' 78:25-32 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 78:25-32 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 78:25-32 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.
A fitting recompense: the punishment matches what they did.

questions.q: Why does the surah move from punishment (78:21 to 30) to reward (78:31)?
questions.a: To balance fear and hope, which a believer holds together.

questions.q: What is promised to the righteous in 78:31 to 32?
questions.a: A) Attainment: gardens and grapevines. 78:31 to 32.

questions.q: An-Naba' 78:27: «إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: 'Everything We have enumerated in writing' (78:29). How does knowing that every deed is recorded change how you spend a day?
questions.a: It makes us careful with small things too: words, time and how we treat people.
